named-query.name: Persons.withPartners
named-query.query: select p from Person p where p.partner is not null

named-query.name: Persons.withPhoners
named-query.query: select distinct p from Person p inner join p.phones pp

named-query.name: Persons.withEmails
named-query.query: select distinct p from Person p inner join p.emails pe

named-native-query.name: Persons.greaterOrEqualtoAge
named-native-query.query: select p.id, p.peType, p.first_name, p.gender, p.weight, p.height, p.birth_date, p.death_date, p.date_insert, p.date_update, p.partner_id from persons p where p.death_date is null and (extract(year from current_date) - extract(year from p.birth_date)) >= ?1
